what: the sea ice by month (H1b R5, V3 A): tools/is/is.py makes src/data/is.json from OSI SAF's sea ice concentration climate data record (OSI-450-a, EUMETSAT, CC BY 4.0), the mean of each month 1991-2020. Changing this file starts .github/workflows/is.yml, which keeps the result as a release is-<run number>.
